title: monarda fistulosa var. stipitatoglandulosa
intro: Monarda fistulosa var. stipitatoglandulosa, commonly known as Bee Balm or Wild Bergamot, is a fragrant perennial plant native to North America. This plant has been traditionally used to treat various health issues, including sore throats, colds, and fever, due to its antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Monarda fistulosa var. stipitatoglandulosa include expectorant, antiseptic, and anti-inflammatory effects, which help to relieve respiratory issues and soothe wounds. The bioactive constituents of this plant include monoterpenes, sesquiterpenes, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
